issues.description: The example main code in the template (Main.java) calls farm.feed(), but the problem statement and the intended API use feedAllAnimals() (and the solution implements feedAllAnimals()). This name mismatch between the template's example usage and the specified/implemented Farm API will confuse students trying to run or follow the example and may lead them to implement the wrong method name or think a different API is required.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template example consistent with the specification: update the commented example in Main.java to call farm.feedAllAnimals() instead of farm.feed(); alternatively, add a small convenience method feed() in Farm that delegates to feedAllAnimals() and document it. Ensure the problem statement, template example, and provided solution all use the same method name.

issues.description: The problem statement (and the solution) specify a Farm method named feedAllAnimals(), but the template Main.java calls farm.feed(). This creates a naming mismatch for the same conceptual operation (feeding all animals) across artifacts and can confuse students about which method to implement or call.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the template Main.java to call farm.feedAllAnimals() instead of farm.feed(), or alternatively provide a feed() wrapper in the Farm template that delegates to feedAllAnimals(), so the method name is consistent with the problem statement and solution.
